title: Oahu in a Day: Small Group Waterfall, Food Trucks, and Lookouts
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Bring a bathing suit for the waterfall
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Oʻahu like never before on this immersive full-day circle island adventure, designed for travelers who want more than just a drive-by tour.

What sets us apart? We combine stunning photo opportunities with authentic local experiences — all in a relaxed, small-group setting.

Start your day with locally grown coffee at a Hawaiian farm, then take a refreshing swim at Waimea Valley’s waterfall, surrounded by tropical gardens. Capture iconic surf breaks on the North Shore before savoring lunch at the famous Kahuku food trucks.

We’ll explore cultural gems like tropical farms and scenic marvels including Chinaman’s Hat, the Pali Lookout, Makapuʻu cliffs, and the Halona Blowhole.

End the day on a sweet note with fresh malasadas from a local favorite.

From waterfalls to coastlines, temples to food trucks — this is the ultimate way to experience the real Oʻahu.
